title: Dormant begin-recovery format, cancellation-proof and exact ACK contracts
outcome: Independently tested dormant data/persistence prerequisites; no active recovery state or runtime behavior is introduced, and foundation/parent recovery remains incomplete.
acceptance: This stage is a dormant prerequisite only. Production changes are limited to the isolated recovery format/validation/ACK module, its include and unused exact persistence fence support. It adds no live session recovery fields, persisted-record fields, serializer/loader integration, admission/Begin/delivery callers, containment policy or operator-cancel activation. Production constructs no new recovery fence target or recovery context and calls none of the new ACK methods. Static call-site review and regression tests demonstrate that ordinary production operations cannot enter a new held state or require an unimplemented cancel exit.

Pure typed contracts retain exact envelope identity/revision, authority, replay payload, phase and settlement, plus distinct local ACK/reply/owner failure kinds. Round-trip and identity controls preserve the original grant, delivery tokens, begin key, grant basis, retained head/dispatch identity and session/project/store/connection/settings/work-binding data without substitution. These tests establish data contracts only, not first-send ownership, replay or provider delivery.

The pure raw decoder preserves the original envelope, audit, markers, cancellation capture and cancellation audit when any recovery-only field is malformed or inconsistent. Tests cover valid data, missing fields, malformed envelope/audit/marker/tuple and surviving modern evidence; partial modern invalidity never becomes a legacy authorization or proves a terminal outcome by itself. An independently verified coherent local cancellation proof remains valid when only transport replay fields are invalid. The decoder neither mutates unrelated session/head data nor fabricates an envelope, key, pre-wire ACK, replay or admission authority. This stage does not connect the decoder to the production loader.

Pure cancellation validation requires a verified local identity/revision/head/text and applicable grant/key audit. Positive terminal proof requires the coherent matching cancellation capture/audit, the exact old head absent, and its full original text preserved in the identified cancellation message. Negative controls cover mismatched operation/revision/head/text/audit and a surviving old head; a successor cannot substitute for or be retired as the old head. Legacy local-cancel data does not fabricate a historical envelope, key or ACK. No operator action or production usable-exit claim is activated here.

The unused recovery ACK/fence contract compares the complete coherent recovery image by exact durable readback and reports failure/ambiguity/deadline instead of success when it cannot establish that image. Disposable persistence tests exercise matching readback, mismatch, failed/unknown ACK and budget expiry; no lock spans a persistence wait. Existing production fence variants and healthy persistence/admission/bind/abort/initial-delivery behavior remain covered and unchanged. Documentation identifies this as dormant support and leaves active foundation, automatic recovery and parent incident claims open.

The holder reports native production added/deleted lines against the exact authorized predecessor commit, counting cfg(test) seams, with every forecast measured from a complete candidate tree that passes `cargo fmt -- --check` in repository context, using native Git numstat against the stage's exact base. The stage stays at or below 400 ADDED production lines, forecasts before writing and recounts its final actual input; overrun stops for a new disposition without compression or safeguard removal. Its own named-root final exact input has a passed maintained full gate/host Test record, an independent read-only Codex/Claude pair without outstanding in-scope Medium+, filed remaining Lows and independent acceptance. The provisional failed root/logs remain preserved. This prerequisite claims none of foundation F1-F7 or its seven bindings.
